HOSTING_CLAP_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the clap dimension: hosting.clap.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

text.en: Not every extension this plugin declares is covered by what was checked. Check the plugin against the extensions this host covers, or accept the gap.
This host does not host the CLAP format. Use a host that does.
The plugin failed while being checked headless, with no window. Fix what failed and check it again.
The plugin’s reported latency does not match what was measured. Trust the measured figure, not the plugin’s own report.

clapNoteInput.doc: the plugin declares a note input the configuration refuses

text.en: This configuration refuses the note input the plugin declares. Run the plugin in a configuration that accepts its note input, or without notes.
The plugin’s processing call returned an error. Treat the plugin as faulty for this block.
The plugin called back from the wrong thread. Treat the plugin as not thread-safe.
This plugin has not been qualified for hosting. Qualify it before relying on it.
